# AI Issue Triage workflow uses Cursor CLI to analyze and triage GitHub issues
name: AI Issue Triage

on:
  issues:
    types: [labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: "Issue number to triage"
        required: true
        type: number
      model:
        description: "Model to use for the triage"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "grok-4.7-xhigh"

# Computed issue number and model for use in jobs
env:
  ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number || github.event.issue.number }}
  MODEL: ${{ github.event.inputs.model || 'grok-4.7-xhigh' }}

jobs:
  # Job 1: AI performs the triage analysis with READ-ONLY access
  ai-issue-triage:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'ai-review'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    permissions:
      # Do not give the agent write access to keep it a safe operation
      contents: read
      issues: read

    # Avoid duplicate workflows on same issue (use issue number for per-issue isolation)
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.event.inputs.issue_number || github.event.issue.number }}-ai-triage
      cancel-in-progress: true

    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Streamlit code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: "recursive"
          # Give the agent full git history access:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Cursor CLI
        run: |
          curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
          echo "$HOME/.cursor/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Download open issues CSV
        run: |
          if ! curl -sfL "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/streamlit/st-issues/refs/heads/main/static/github_issues_open_cleaned_all_summarized.csv" -o open_issues.csv; then
            echo "Error: Failed to download issues CSV"
            exit 1
          fi
          if [ ! -s open_issues.csv ]; then
            echo "Error: Downloaded CSV is empty"
            exit 1
          fi

      # Only needed for manual runs (workflow_dispatch), where there is no
      # `github.event.issue` payload. For the `issues` trigger we read the
      # title/URL from the event context directly (see env block below).
      - name: Get issue details (workflow_dispatch only)
        id: issue-info
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          ISSUE_DATA=$(gh issue view "$ISSUE_NUMBER" --repo "${{ github.repository }}" --json title,url)
          echo "html_url=$(echo "$ISSUE_DATA" | jq -r '.url')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "title=$(echo "$ISSUE_DATA" | jq -r '.title')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      # Runs only very basic triage (first-level support) based on the
      # issue information and historical issues. This will detect
      # related issues / duplicates, suggest feature labels, and gives
      # a brief initial assessment of the issue. We will add more advanced
      # issue analysis in future iterations.
      - name: "AI Issue Triage - Duplicates & Labels"
        env:
          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          # Prefer the values from the event payload so we use the issue state
          # as it was when the workflow was triggered, falling back to the
          # API-derived outputs for manual (workflow_dispatch) runs.
          ISSUE_URL: ${{ github.event.issue.html_url || steps.issue-info.outputs.html_url }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ github.event.issue.title || steps.issue-info.outputs.title }}
        run: |
          cursor-agent -p "You are operating in a GitHub Actions runner to triage a GitHub issue.

          The GitHub CLI (gh) is available for READ operations only. Use it to fetch issue details and search
          for related issues. Git is also available for read operations. The repository is available in the
          current directory with the full git history, but the dev environment is not setup, so you cannot run
          the code or development tasks.

          # Context:
          - Repo: ${{ github.repository }}
          - Issue Number: ${{ env.ISSUE_NUMBER }}
          - Issue URL: $ISSUE_URL
          - Issue Title: $ISSUE_TITLE

          # Available Resources:
          - A CSV file 'open_issues.csv' in the current directory contains all open issues with summaries. Use this to find duplicate or related issues.
          - Use 'gh label list -L 300' to get all existing labels in the repository. ONLY use labels that exist.
          - Use 'gh issue view ${{ env.ISSUE_NUMBER }}' to get full issue details.
          - Use 'gh search issues' to search for related issues if needed.
          - Other read-only operations are available via 'gh' client or `git` command.

          # Goal:
          Analyze this issue and prepare triage information including appropriate labels and related issues.

          # Instructions:

          1. First, get the full issue details:
             - Run 'gh issue view ${{ env.ISSUE_NUMBER }}' to get the issue body and metadata.

          2. Get all existing labels:
             - Run 'gh label list -L 300' to get all valid labels.
             - You MUST only use labels from this list.

          3. Read the open_issues.csv file to understand existing issues, their descriptions, the applied labels.

          4. Analyze the issue:
             - Determine the issue type (bug, enhancement, question, etc.)
             - Identify the relevant feature area(s)
             - Find up to 3 potentially duplicates or existing issues that are closely related to this issue (${{ env.ISSUE_NUMBER }}).
               Its fine to also suggest 0 issues if no related issues or duplicates are found.

          5. For BUG issues specifically:
             - Perform a quick root cause analysis by examining the codebase
             - Look at relevant code files mentioned in the issue or related to the feature
             - Summarize your findings about the potential cause

          6. Create 'labels.txt':
             - One label per line
             - Only include labels that exist in 'gh label list -L 300'
             - Please focus on adding one type label (type:*) and relevant feature labels (feature:st.*, area:*), no other type of labels.

          7. Create 'comment.txt':
             - Start with a brief summary (~2-7 sentences) of the issue analysis
             - List up to 3 potentially duplicate or closely related issues with links and brief explanations of why they're related
             - Be concise but informative
             - Use GitHub-flavored markdown formatting

          # Output Format for comment.txt:

          <output-start>
          [Brief analysis of what this issue is about and the potential root cause if applicable.]

          ### Related Issues

          [List of up to 3 related issues with links and brief explanations. If no related issues found, state that.]

          ---
          *This is an automated triage comment using \`$MODEL\`. Please verify the suggested labels and related issues.*
          <output-end>

          # Important Notes:
          - Do NOT attempt to post comments, edit issues, or perform any write operations - they will fail.
          - Do NOT run test, lint, or build commands (the dev environment is not setup!).
          - Focus on analysis and generating the output files.
          " --force --model "$MODEL" --output-format=text

      - name: Upload triage artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: triage-output
          path: |
            labels.txt
            comment.txt
          retention-days: 1

  # Job 2: Post the triage results with WRITE access (no agent)
  ai-issue-post-triage:
    needs: ai-issue-triage
    # Run on success or failure, but NOT when skipped (i.e., label wasn't 'ai-review')
    if: always() && needs.ai-issue-triage.result != 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      issues: write

    steps:
      - name: Remove 'ai-review' label
        if: github.event_name == 'issues'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh issue edit ${{ env.ISSUE_NUMBER }} --remove-label "ai-review" --repo ${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Download triage artifacts
        id: download
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: triage-output

      - name: Apply labels
        if: steps.download.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ ! -f labels.txt ]; then
            echo "Warning: labels.txt not found, skipping label application"
            exit 0
          fi

          # Only add new labels from labels.txt, never remove existing ones
          while IFS= read -r label || [ -n "$label" ]; do
            # Skip empty lines
            if [ -n "$label" ]; then
              echo "Adding label: $label"
              gh issue edit ${{ env.ISSUE_NUMBER }} --add-label "$label" --repo ${{ github.repository }} || echo "Warning: Failed to add label '$label'"
            fi
          done < labels.txt

      - name: Post triage comment
        if: steps.download.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ ! -f comment.txt ]; then
            echo "Warning: comment.txt not found, skipping comment"
            exit 0
          fi
          gh issue comment ${{ env.ISSUE_NUMBER }} --body-file comment.txt --repo ${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Post failure notice
        if: steps.download.outcome == 'failure'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          gh issue comment ${{ env.ISSUE_NUMBER }} --body "⚠️ **AI Triage Failed**

          The AI triage job failed to complete. Please check the [workflow run](${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}/actions/runs/${{ github.run_id }}) for details.

          You can retry by adding the \`ai-review\` label again or manually triggering the workflow." --repo ${{ github.repository }}
files..github/workflows/ai-pr-review.yml:
# AI Review workflow uses Cursor CLI to review PRs
name: AI PR Review

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: "PR number to review"
        required: true
        type: number
      model:
        description: "Model(s) to use for the review (comma-separated for multi-model). The last model serves as the 'judge' for consolidating reviews. Leave empty to use the repository default."
        required: false
        type: string

# Computed PR number and model sets for use in jobs
# Model priority: manual input > ai-final-review label > repository variable (AI_PR_REVIEW_MODELS) > default
env:
  PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
  MODEL_INPUT: ${{ github.event.inputs.model || '' }}
  DEFAULT_AI_PR_REVIEW_MODELS: ${{ vars.AI_PR_REVIEW_MODELS || 'gpt-5.6-terra-xhigh,claude-opus-5-5-medium,grok-4.7-xhigh' }}
  FINAL_AI_PR_REVIEW_MODELS: "gpt-5.6-sol-high,claude-opus-5-5-high,gemini-3.8-flash-high,grok-4.7-xhigh"

jobs:
  # Job 1: Parse model list and check for API key
  parse-models:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'ai-review' || github.event.label.name == 'ai-final-review'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      models_json: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.models_json }}
      model_count: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.model_count }}
      judge_model: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.judge_model }}
      judge_model_id: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.judge_model_id }}
      trigger_label: ${{ steps.parse.outputs.trigger_label }}
      has_key: ${{ steps.check-key.outputs.has_key }}
    steps:
      - name: Check for API key
        id: check-key
        env:
          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$CURSOR_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo "has_key=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "::warning::CURSOR_API_KEY is not available. This typically happens for PRs from forks."
          else
            echo "has_key=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

      - name: Parse model list
        id: parse
        env:
          EVENT_LABEL: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
        run: |
          REVIEW_LABEL=""
          if [ "$EVENT_LABEL" = "ai-review" ] || [ "$EVENT_LABEL" = "ai-final-review" ]; then
            REVIEW_LABEL="$EVENT_LABEL"
          fi

          if [ "$REVIEW_LABEL" = "ai-final-review" ]; then
            FALLBACK_MODEL="$FINAL_AI_PR_REVIEW_MODELS"
          else
            FALLBACK_MODEL="$DEFAULT_AI_PR_REVIEW_MODELS"
          fi

          MODEL="$MODEL_INPUT"
          if [ -z "${MODEL// /}" ]; then
            MODEL="$FALLBACK_MODEL"
          fi

          # Split comma-separated, trim whitespace, convert to JSON array
          # Use $MODEL shell variable instead of direct expression interpolation for security
          MODELS_JSON=$(echo "$MODEL" | tr ',' '\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//' | grep -v '^$' | jq -R . | jq -sc .)

          # Verify we have at least one model
          MODEL_COUNT=$(echo "$MODELS_JSON" | jq 'length')
          if [ "$MODEL_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "::error::No valid models found after parsing. Using fallback."
            MODELS_JSON=$(echo "$FALLBACK_MODEL" | tr ',' '\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//' | grep -v '^$' | jq -R . | jq -sc .)
            MODEL_COUNT=$(echo "$MODELS_JSON" | jq 'length')
          fi

          # The last model in the list serves as the "judge" for consolidating multi-model reviews
          JUDGE_MODEL=$(echo "$MODELS_JSON" | jq -r '.[-1]')
          # Sanitized version for artifact naming (same logic as sanitize step)
          JUDGE_MODEL_ID=$(echo "$JUDGE_MODEL" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/-/g; s/--*/-/g; s/^-//; s/-$//')

          echo "models_json=$MODELS_JSON" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "model_count=$MODEL_COUNT" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "judge_model=$JUDGE_MODEL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "judge_model_id=$JUDGE_MODEL_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "trigger_label=$REVIEW_LABEL" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

          echo "Parsed models: $MODELS_JSON"
          echo "Model count: $MODEL_COUNT"
          echo "Judge model: $JUDGE_MODEL"
          echo "Judge model ID: $JUDGE_MODEL_ID"
          echo "Trigger label: ${REVIEW_LABEL:-manual}"

  # Job 2: AI performs the review with READ-ONLY access (matrix for multi-model)
  ai-pr-review:
    needs: parse-models
    if: needs.parse-models.outputs.has_key == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read

    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        model: ${{ fromJson(needs.parse-models.outputs.models_json) }}

    # Avoid duplicate workflows on same PR (use PR number for per-PR isolation)
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-pr-${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number || github.event.pull_request.number }}-${{ matrix.model }}
      cancel-in-progress: true

    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash

    steps:
      - name: Sanitize model name for artifact
        id: sanitize
        env:
          MATRIX_MODEL: ${{ matrix.model }}
        run: |
          # Replace special characters with dashes for artifact naming
          # Use $MATRIX_MODEL shell variable instead of ${{ matrix.model }} for security
          MODEL_ID=$(echo "$MATRIX_MODEL" | sed 's/[^a-zA-Z0-9]/-/g; s/--*/-/g; s/^-//; s/-$//')
          echo "model_id=$MODEL_ID" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "Using model ID: $MODEL_ID"

      - name: Get PR details
        id: pr-info
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
        run: |
          PR_DATA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER_ENV")
          echo "head_sha=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.head.sha')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "head_ref=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.head.ref')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "base_ref=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.base.ref')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "html_url=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.html_url')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Checkout Streamlit code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          # Use SHA instead of branch name to support fork PRs
          ref: ${{ steps.pr-info.outputs.head_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: "recursive"
          # Give the agent full git history access:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install Cursor CLI
        run: |
          curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
          echo "$HOME/.cursor/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Cursor AI PR Review
        env:
          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          MATRIX_MODEL: ${{ matrix.model }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          PR_HTML_URL: ${{ steps.pr-info.outputs.html_url }}
          PR_BASE_REF: ${{ steps.pr-info.outputs.base_ref }}
          PR_HEAD_REF: ${{ steps.pr-info.outputs.head_ref }}
        run: |
          PROMPT="You are operating in a GitHub Actions runner to perform a code review on a pull request. The branch is already checked out.

          ## Context

          - Repository: $REPOSITORY
          - Main branch: develop
          - PR Number: $PR_NUMBER_ENV
          - PR URL: $PR_HTML_URL
          - Base Ref: $PR_BASE_REF
          - Head Ref: $PR_HEAD_REF

          Gather additional context as needed:

          The GitHub CLI (gh) is available for READ operations to get PR details, diff, and file contents, for example:

          \`\`\`bash
          # Get PR for current branch
          gh pr view --json number,title,url,headRefName

          # Get PR description and metadata
          gh pr view --json title,body,labels,author

          # List changed files
          gh pr diff --name-only

          # All changes
          gh pr diff
          \`\`\`

          \`git\` is also available for read operations.

          ## Goal

          Review this branch (PR: $PR_HTML_URL) and ensure the changes are bug-free, backwards compatible, aligned with Streamlit's product and API principles, and ready for merge.

          $(cat scripts/assets/code-review-instructions.md)

          $(cat scripts/assets/code-review-inline-comments-instructions.md)

          ## Finalize Review:

          1. In the review footer, replace 'This is an automated AI review.' with 'This is an automated AI review by \`$MATRIX_MODEL\`.'
          2. Write inline comments to \`inline_comments.json\` following the schema and rules in the Inline Comments section above.
          3. Write the PR-level review body to \`review.md\`.
          4. Write either \`APPROVED\` or \`CHANGES_REQUESTED\` (exactly one of these) to \`verdict.txt\`.

          "
          cursor-agent -p "$PROMPT" --force --model "$MATRIX_MODEL" --output-format=text

          if [ ! -f inline_comments.json ]; then
            echo '{"comments":[]}' > inline_comments.json
          fi

      - name: Upload review artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: review-output-${{ steps.sanitize.outputs.model_id }}
          path: |
            review.md
            inline_comments.json
            verdict.txt
          retention-days: 1

  # Job 3: Consolidate multiple reviews into one (only runs for multi-model)
  consolidate-reviews:
    needs: [parse-models, ai-pr-review]
    # Default model_count to 0: fromJson() errors on empty input when parse-models is skipped.
    if: always() && fromJson(needs.parse-models.outputs.model_count || '0') > 1 && needs.parse-models.outputs.has_key == 'true' && needs.ai-pr-review.result != 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    outputs:
      review_count: ${{ steps.count-reviews.outputs.review_count }}
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read

    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Download all review artifacts
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          pattern: review-output-*
          path: reviews/

      - name: List downloaded reviews
        run: |
          echo "Downloaded review artifacts:"
          ls -la reviews/ || echo "No reviews directory"
          for dir in reviews/review-output-*; do
            if [ -d "$dir" ]; then
              echo "=== $dir ==="
              ls -la "$dir"
            fi
          done

      - name: Count reviews
        id: count-reviews
        run: |
          shopt -s nullglob
          REVIEW_COUNT=0
          for dir in reviews/review-output-*; do
            [ -s "$dir/review.md" ] || continue
            REVIEW_COUNT=$((REVIEW_COUNT + 1))
          done
          echo "review_count=$REVIEW_COUNT" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "Found $REVIEW_COUNT individual review(s)"

      - name: Install Cursor CLI
        run: |
          curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
          echo "$HOME/.cursor/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Consolidate reviews
        env:
          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          MODELS_JSON: ${{ needs.parse-models.outputs.models_json }}
          JUDGE_MODEL: ${{ needs.parse-models.outputs.judge_model }}
        run: |
          # Build the reviews content into a file (avoids shell interpretation issues)
          REVIEWS_FILE="all_reviews.md"
          > "$REVIEWS_FILE"

          REVIEW_COUNT=0
          INLINE_CANDIDATES_FILE="all_inline_comments.json"
          echo '{"comments":[]}' > "$INLINE_CANDIDATES_FILE"
          for dir in reviews/review-output-*; do
            if [ -d "$dir" ] && [ -f "$dir/review.md" ]; then
              model_id=$(basename "$dir" | sed 's/review-output-//')
              echo "### Review from $model_id" >> "$REVIEWS_FILE"
              echo "" >> "$REVIEWS_FILE"
              cat "$dir/review.md" >> "$REVIEWS_FILE"
              echo "" >> "$REVIEWS_FILE"
              echo "---" >> "$REVIEWS_FILE"
              echo "" >> "$REVIEWS_FILE"
              REVIEW_COUNT=$((REVIEW_COUNT + 1))
            fi

            if [ -d "$dir" ] && [ -f "$dir/inline_comments.json" ]; then
              if jq -e '.comments | type == "array"' "$dir/inline_comments.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
                jq -s '{comments: (map(.comments // []) | add // [])}' "$INLINE_CANDIDATES_FILE" "$dir/inline_comments.json" > inline_merge_tmp.json
                mv inline_merge_tmp.json "$INLINE_CANDIDATES_FILE"
              fi
            fi
          done

          if [ "$REVIEW_COUNT" -eq 0 ]; then
            echo "Error: No reviews found to consolidate"
            exit 1
          fi

          echo "Found $REVIEW_COUNT reviews to consolidate"

          # Write prompt to file using heredoc with placeholder substitution
          # (avoids shell interpretation of review content and heredoc split issues)
          cat > prompt.txt << 'PROMPT_EOF'
          You are a senior code reviewer tasked with consolidating multiple AI code reviews into a single comprehensive review.

          ## Context

          - Repository: streamlit/streamlit
          - Main branch: develop

          Github CLI (`gh`) and the `git` command are available for read operations if needed.

          ## Expected Models:
          __MODELS_JSON__

          ## Reviews to consolidate:
          Read the file `all_reviews.md` in the current directory for all individual reviews.
          Read the file `all_inline_comments.json` for candidate inline comments from individual reviews.

          ## Your Task:

          1. **Synthesize** the reviews into a single comprehensive review that captures all important findings
          2. **Note agreement/disagreement** - highlight where reviewers agreed and where they differed
          3. **Resolve conflicts** - use your judgment or own verification to determine the correct assessment when reviewers disagree
          4. **Track missing reviews** - if any expected models are missing from the reviews above, note them as 'failed to complete review'
          5. **Determine final verdict**:
             - APPROVED: If the majority of available reviews approve AND there are no critical/merge-blocking issues raised by any reviewer. Minor suggestions or optional improvements should not block approval — those can be addressed in follow-up PRs.
             - CHANGES_REQUESTED: If majority request changes OR any reviewer raised critical/merge-blocking issues (bugs, security vulnerabilities, material performance regressions, breaking changes, missing required tests, or clear material violations of documented Streamlit product/API principles and patterns). Optional improvements, style preferences, and "nice to have" suggestions should NOT result in CHANGES_REQUESTED.

          __CONSOLIDATION_INSTRUCTIONS__

          ## Output Format:

          Follow the same output format used by the individual reviews you are consolidating.
          Use the exact section structure and ordering defined in `scripts/assets/code-review-instructions.md` under "Output Format".
          Do not add extra top-level sections beyond that template.
          Mention the consolidation model - `__JUDGE_MODEL__` - in the footer.
          Do not attach or embed the individual reviews in the output. The consolidated review should stand on its own.

          ## Finalize:
          1. Write triaged inline comments to \`inline_comments.json\` following the schema and rules in the Inline Comments Triage section above.
          2. Write your consolidated PR-level review body to \`review.md\`.
          3. Write either \`APPROVED\` or \`CHANGES_REQUESTED\` to \`verdict.txt\`
          PROMPT_EOF

          # Replace placeholders using awk with ENVIRON (safely handles JSON double quotes).
          # Note: awk gsub treats '&' and '\' as special chars in replacements. The current
          # placeholder values don't contain these, so this is safe. If future content includes
          # them, switch to envsubst or a Python-based substitution.
          export CONSOLIDATION_INSTRUCTIONS
          CONSOLIDATION_INSTRUCTIONS="$(cat scripts/assets/code-review-consolidation-instructions.md)"
          awk '{
            gsub(/__MODELS_JSON__/, ENVIRON["MODELS_JSON"])
            gsub(/__JUDGE_MODEL__/, ENVIRON["JUDGE_MODEL"])
            gsub(/__CONSOLIDATION_INSTRUCTIONS__/, ENVIRON["CONSOLIDATION_INSTRUCTIONS"])
            print
          }' prompt.txt > prompt_final.txt && mv prompt_final.txt prompt.txt

          cursor-agent -p "$(cat prompt.txt)" --force --model "$JUDGE_MODEL" --output-format=text

          if [ ! -f inline_comments.json ]; then
            echo '{"comments":[]}' > inline_comments.json
          fi

      - name: Upload consolidated artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: review-output-consolidated
          path: |
            review.md
            inline_comments.json
            verdict.txt
          retention-days: 1

  # Job 4: Post the review with WRITE access (no agent)
  ai-pr-post-review:
    needs: [parse-models, ai-pr-review, consolidate-reviews]
    # Run on success or failure, but NOT when skipped (i.e., label wasn't an AI review label)
    if: always() && needs.parse-models.result != 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      # Required for posting comments, but this step is safe since it is not running the agent operation:
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - name: Remove AI review request label
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          EVENT_LABEL: ${{ github.event.label.name }}
        run: |
          # Derive the label to remove from the triggering event rather than the
          # parse-models output, so the label is still cleaned up even if the parse
          # step failed. The equality checks keep removal limited to known labels.
          if [ "$EVENT_LABEL" = "ai-review" ] || [ "$EVENT_LABEL" = "ai-final-review" ]; then
            gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --remove-label "$EVENT_LABEL" --repo "$REPOSITORY" || true
          fi

      - name: Download consolidated review
        id: download-consolidated
        if: needs.consolidate-reviews.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: review-output-consolidated

      - name: Download judge model review (fallback for failed consolidation)
        id: download-single
        # When consolidation fails or wasn't run, fall back to posting just the judge model's review.
        # This provides a deterministic fallback rather than randomly selecting from multiple reviews.
        if: steps.download-consolidated.outcome != 'success' && needs.parse-models.outputs.has_key == 'true'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: review-output-${{ needs.parse-models.outputs.judge_model_id }}

      - name: Post missing key notice
        if: needs.parse-models.outputs.has_key == 'false'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          TRIGGER_LABEL: ${{ needs.parse-models.outputs.trigger_label }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$TRIGGER_LABEL" ]; then
            REQUEST_SOURCE="The \`$TRIGGER_LABEL\` label cannot trigger AI reviews for this PR"
          else
            REQUEST_SOURCE="The AI PR Review workflow cannot run for this PR"
          fi

          cat > missing-key-comment.md <<EOF
          ℹ️ **AI Review Not Available**

          ${REQUEST_SOURCE} because the required API key is not available. This typically happens for PRs from forked repositories.

          **To request an AI review, a maintainer can:**
          1. Go to the [AI PR Review workflow](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/actions/workflows/ai-pr-review.yml)
          2. Click **Run workflow**
          3. Enter the PR number: \`$PR_NUMBER_ENV\`
          4. Click **Run workflow**
          EOF

          gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --body-file missing-key-comment.md --repo "$REPOSITORY"

      - name: Post review
        id: post_review
        if: needs.parse-models.outputs.has_key == 'true' && (steps.download-consolidated.outcome == 'success' || steps.download-single.outcome == 'success')
        continue-on-error: true
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          # Verify review file exists before modifying
          if [ ! -f review.md ]; then
            echo "Error: review.md not found"
            exit 1
          fi

          # Add hidden marker at the end of the review for programmatic detection
          # Format: <!-- streamlit-ai-review run_id="..." timestamp="..." -->
          TIMESTAMP=$(date -u +"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ")
          echo "" >> review.md
          echo "<!-- streamlit-ai-review run_id=\"$RUN_ID\" timestamp=\"$TIMESTAMP\" -->" >> review.md
          # Always post the review body as COMMENT. A later step posts a formal
          # APPROVE for ai-final-review only (never REQUEST_CHANGES). verdict.txt
          # still drives labels such as do-not-merge.
          EVENT="COMMENT"

          # Get head SHA for review API
          HEAD_SHA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --jq '.head.sha')

          # Build inline comments array (default to empty if missing/invalid).
          # Note: We don't pre-validate path/line against the PR diff here for simplicity.
          # GitHub's Reviews API validates that each path/line falls within the diff and
          # returns 422 if any comment is invalid. If that happens, we fall back to posting
          # the review body plus a formatted summary of the inline comments as a plain comment.
          if [ -f inline_comments.json ]; then
            # Filters: require path, line, body; line must be a positive integer (rejects 0
            # which the Reviews API would 422 on); hard cap at 20 comments as a guardrail
            # beyond the model prompt instructions; side is always RIGHT since AI review
            # comments target added/modified code.
            INLINE_COMMENTS=$(jq '[.comments[]? | select(.path and .line and .body) | select(.line | tostring | test("^[1-9][0-9]*$")) | {path, line: (.line | tonumber), body, side: "RIGHT"}] | .[0:20]' inline_comments.json 2>/dev/null || echo '[]')
          else
            INLINE_COMMENTS='[]'
          fi

          # Append inline comment count note to review.md if there are inline comments
          INLINE_COUNT=$(echo "$INLINE_COMMENTS" | jq 'length')
          if [ "$INLINE_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
            echo "" >> review.md
            echo "*This review also includes ${INLINE_COUNT} inline comment(s) on specific code lines.*" >> review.md
          fi

          # Build and post review payload
          if jq -n \
            --rawfile body review.md \
            --arg event "$EVENT" \
            --arg commit_id "$HEAD_SHA" \
            --argjson comments "$INLINE_COMMENTS" \
            '{body: $body, event: $event, commit_id: $commit_id, comments: $comments}' \
            | gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER_ENV/reviews" -X POST --input -; then
            echo "Review posted successfully with $(echo "$INLINE_COMMENTS" | jq 'length') inline comments"
          else
            echo "::warning::Review API failed, falling back to plain comment with inline summary"
            # Build a fallback comment that includes both the review body and inline comments.
            # Since we always post as COMMENT (not APPROVE/REQUEST_CHANGES), no verdict is
            # lost when falling back to a plain comment — the review content is fully preserved.
            INLINE_SUMMARY=""
            INLINE_COUNT=$(echo "$INLINE_COMMENTS" | jq 'length')
            if [ "$INLINE_COUNT" -gt 0 ]; then
              INLINE_SUMMARY=$(echo "$INLINE_COMMENTS" | jq -r '
                "\n\n---\n\n<details>\n<summary>Inline comments (" + (length | tostring) + ") that could not be posted on specific lines</summary>\n\n" +
                (map("**`" + .path + "` (line " + (.line | tostring) + ")**\n" + .body + "\n") | join("\n---\n\n")) +
                "\n</details>"
              ')
            fi
            # Append inline summary to review body and post as plain comment
            { cat review.md; echo "$INLINE_SUMMARY"; } | gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --body-file - --repo "$REPOSITORY"
          fi

      - name: Post failure notice
        if: needs.parse-models.outputs.has_key == 'true' && (steps.post_review.outcome == 'failure' || (steps.download-consolidated.outcome != 'success' && steps.download-single.outcome != 'success'))
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          SERVER_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          TRIGGER_LABEL: ${{ needs.parse-models.outputs.trigger_label }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$TRIGGER_LABEL" ]; then
            RETRY_TEXT="You can retry by adding the \`$TRIGGER_LABEL\` label again or manually triggering the workflow."
          else
            RETRY_TEXT="You can retry by manually triggering the workflow."
          fi

          cat > failure-comment.md <<EOF
          ⚠️ **AI Review Failed**

          The AI review job failed to complete. Please check the [workflow run](${SERVER_URL}/$REPOSITORY/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}) for details.

          ${RETRY_TEXT}
          EOF

          gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --body-file failure-comment.md --repo "$REPOSITORY"

      - name: Apply label based on verdict
        if: needs.parse-models.outputs.has_key == 'true' && (steps.download-consolidated.outcome == 'success' || steps.download-single.outcome == 'success') && steps.post_review.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          if [ ! -f verdict.txt ]; then
            echo "Warning: verdict.txt not found, skipping label"
            exit 0
          fi

          VERDICT=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < verdict.txt)
          if [ "$VERDICT" = "CHANGES_REQUESTED" ]; then
            echo "Adding 'do-not-merge' label"
            gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --add-label "do-not-merge" --repo "$REPOSITORY"
          elif [ "$VERDICT" = "APPROVED" ]; then
            echo "Removing 'do-not-merge' label if present"
            gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --remove-label "do-not-merge" --repo "$REPOSITORY" || true
          fi

      # Auto-approve ai-final-review PRs with an APPROVED verdict, except:
      # - change:spec (always needs a human, regardless of impact)
      # - change:feature + impact:users (new user-facing features)
      # - more than 1000 changed lines (additions + deletions)
      # - PR originates from a fork
      # - fewer reviews were reported than configured models
      # Bugfixes, chores, docs, and other impact:users PRs stay eligible:
      # they are lower-risk than new user-facing features and benefit most
      # from the speedup.
      # Requires the repository/organization Actions setting "Allow GitHub
      # Actions to create and approve pull requests" (Settings > Actions >
      # General > Workflow permissions).
      # GitHub does not count GITHUB_TOKEN approvals toward required
      # CODEOWNERS reviews.
      # Approval targets the current PR HEAD. We intentionally trust contributors
      # not to push unreviewed changes after approval.
      - name: Auto-approve on final review
        if: needs.parse-models.outputs.has_key == 'true' && needs.parse-models.outputs.trigger_label == 'ai-final-review' && (steps.download-consolidated.outcome == 'success' || steps.download-single.outcome == 'success') && steps.post_review.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          GITHUB_SERVER_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}
          GITHUB_RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
          MODEL_COUNT: ${{ needs.parse-models.outputs.model_count }}
          REVIEW_COUNT: ${{ needs.consolidate-reviews.outputs.review_count }}
          CONSOLIDATED_REVIEW_OUTCOME: ${{ steps.download-consolidated.outcome }}
        run: |
          if [ ! -f verdict.txt ]; then
            echo "Skipping auto-approve: verdict.txt not found"
            exit 0
          fi

          VERDICT=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < verdict.txt)
          if [ "$VERDICT" != "APPROVED" ]; then
            echo "Skipping auto-approve: verdict is '$VERDICT' (expected APPROVED)"
            exit 0
          fi

          if ! [[ "$MODEL_COUNT" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
            echo "::warning::Could not parse configured model count, skipping auto-approve"
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$MODEL_COUNT" -gt 1 ] && [ "$CONSOLIDATED_REVIEW_OUTCOME" != "success" ]; then
            echo "Skipping auto-approve: multi-model reviews were not successfully consolidated"
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$MODEL_COUNT" -eq 1 ]; then
            REVIEW_COUNT=1
          fi
          if ! [[ "$REVIEW_COUNT" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::warning::Could not parse reported review count, skipping auto-approve"
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$REVIEW_COUNT" -lt "$MODEL_COUNT" ]; then
            echo "Skipping auto-approve: only $REVIEW_COUNT/$MODEL_COUNT configured models reported reviews"
            exit 0
          fi

          if ! PR_JSON=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER_ENV"); then
            echo "::warning::Failed to fetch PR, skipping auto-approve"
            exit 0
          fi

          HEAD_REPO_ID=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq -r 'if (.head.repo.id | type) == "number" then .head.repo.id else empty end')
          BASE_REPO_ID=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq -r 'if (.base.repo.id | type) == "number" then .base.repo.id else empty end')
          if ! [[ "$HEAD_REPO_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ && "$BASE_REPO_ID" =~ ^[1-9][0-9]*$ ]]; then
            echo "::warning::Could not parse PR repository IDs, skipping auto-approve"
            exit 0
          fi
          if [ "$HEAD_REPO_ID" != "$BASE_REPO_ID" ]; then
            echo "Skipping auto-approve: PR originates from a fork (head repository $HEAD_REPO_ID, base repository $BASE_REPO_ID)"
            exit 0
          fi

          LABELS=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq -c '[.labels[].name]')
          echo "PR labels: $LABELS"

          if echo "$LABELS" | jq -e 'index("change:spec") != null' >/dev/null; then
            echo "Skipping auto-approve: PR is labeled change:spec"
            exit 0
          fi

          HAS_FEATURE=$(echo "$LABELS" | jq 'index("change:feature") != null')
          HAS_USERS=$(echo "$LABELS" | jq 'index("impact:users") != null')
          if [ "$HAS_FEATURE" = "true" ] && [ "$HAS_USERS" = "true" ]; then
            echo "Skipping auto-approve: PR is labeled change:feature and impact:users"
            exit 0
          fi

          ADDITIONS=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq -r '.additions')
          DELETIONS=$(echo "$PR_JSON" | jq -r '.deletions')
          if ! [[ "$ADDITIONS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ && "$DELETIONS" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            echo "::warning::Could not parse PR line counts, skipping auto-approve"
            exit 0
          fi
          CHANGED_LINES=$((ADDITIONS + DELETIONS))
          echo "PR changed lines: $CHANGED_LINES (additions=$ADDITIONS, deletions=$DELETIONS)"
          if [ "$CHANGED_LINES" -gt 1000 ]; then
            echo "Skipping auto-approve: PR has $CHANGED_LINES changed lines (limit 1000)"
            exit 0
          fi

          echo "Auto-approving PR #$PR_NUMBER_ENV based on AI final review verdict"
          if ! jq -n \
            --arg body "Auto-approved by AI final review ([workflow run]($GITHUB_SERVER_URL/$REPOSITORY/actions/runs/$GITHUB_RUN_ID))." \
            '{event: "APPROVE", body: $body}' \
            | gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER_ENV/reviews" -X POST --input -; then
            echo "::warning::Failed to auto-approve PR. Ensure the repository/organization Actions setting 'Allow GitHub Actions to create and approve pull requests' is enabled (Settings > Actions > General > Workflow permissions)."
          fi
files..github/workflows/ai-qa-testing.yml:
# AI QA Testing workflow runs QA tests on a PR branch using Cursor CLI
name: AI QA Testing

on:
  pull_request:
    types: [labeled]
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      pr_number:
        description: "PR number to run QA tests on"
        required: true
        type: number
      model:
        description: "Model to use for QA testing"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "grok-4.7-xhigh"

env:
  PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
  MODEL: ${{ github.event.inputs.model || 'grok-4.7-xhigh' }}

jobs:
  check-secrets:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' || github.event.label.name == 'ai-qa-test'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      has_key: ${{ steps.check-key.outputs.has_key }}
    steps:
      - name: Check for API key
        id: check-key
        env:
          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$CURSOR_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo "has_key=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "::warning::CURSOR_API_KEY is not available. This typically happens for PRs from forks."
          else
            echo "has_key=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  ai-qa-testing:
    needs: check-secrets
    if: needs.check-secrets.outputs.has_key == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest-8-cores
    timeout-minutes: 90
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
      issues: read
      actions: read
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-pr-${{ github.event.inputs.pr_number || github.event.pull_request.number }}
      cancel-in-progress: true

    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash

    steps:
      - name: Get PR details
        id: pr-info
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
        run: |
          PR_DATA=$(gh api "repos/$REPOSITORY/pulls/$PR_NUMBER_ENV")
          echo "head_sha=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.head.sha')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "head_ref=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.head.ref')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "base_ref=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.base.ref')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "html_url=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.html_url')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "title=$(echo "$PR_DATA" | jq -r '.title')" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Checkout Streamlit code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: ${{ steps.pr-info.outputs.head_sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          submodules: "recursive"
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set Python version vars
        uses: ./.github/actions/build_info

      - name: Setup virtual env
        uses: ./.github/actions/make_init
        with:
          python_version: ${{ env.PYTHON_MAX_VERSION }}

      - name: Install playwright
        uses: ./.github/actions/playwright_install

      - name: Build frontend
        run: make frontend-fast

      - name: Clone agent-wiki
        run: |
          git clone https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit.wiki.git agent-wiki

      - name: Install Cursor CLI
        run: |
          curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
          echo "$HOME/.cursor/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: Set up QA directory
        env:
          HEAD_REF: ${{ steps.pr-info.outputs.head_ref }}
        run: |
          # Derive feature name from branch (strip prefix before "/" if present)
          # Falls back to short commit hash in detached-HEAD environments (e.g., CI)
          FEATURE_NAME=$(echo "$HEAD_REF" | sed 's|.*/||')
          FEATURE_NAME=${FEATURE_NAME:-$(git rev-parse --short HEAD)}
          QA_DIR="work-tmp/qa-${FEATURE_NAME}"
          mkdir -p "$QA_DIR"

          # Export for later steps
          echo "QA_DIR=$QA_DIR" >> "$GITHUB_ENV"

      - name: AI QA Testing
        env:
          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          PR_HTML_URL: ${{ steps.pr-info.outputs.html_url }}
        run: |
          PROMPT="You are operating in a GitHub Actions runner to perform QA testing on a pull request.

          ## Context

          - Repository: $REPOSITORY
          - Main branch: develop
          - PR Number: $PR_NUMBER_ENV
          - PR URL: $PR_HTML_URL

          The repository is checked out at the PR's head commit with full git history.
          The dev environment is set up - you can run make commands.
          Playwright browsers are installed for testing.
          The frontend is built and ready.

          The GitHub CLI (gh) is available for READ operations.

          ## Task

          Run the qa-testing-feature subagent to perform comprehensive QA testing on this PR.

          Do not ask for confirmation. Execute tests and document all findings.

          Write the final QA report to '${QA_DIR}/qa-report.md'.
          Write exactly one of PASS, FAIL, or BLOCKED (no formatting, just the word) to '${QA_DIR}/verdict.txt'.
          "
          cursor-agent -p "$PROMPT" --force --model "$MODEL" --output-format=text || true

          # Ensure report and verdict files exist (fallback if cursor-agent fails)
          if [ ! -f "${QA_DIR}/qa-report.md" ]; then
            echo "# QA Testing Report" > "${QA_DIR}/qa-report.md"
            echo "" >> "${QA_DIR}/qa-report.md"
            echo "QA testing did not produce a report." >> "${QA_DIR}/qa-report.md"
          fi

          if [ ! -f "${QA_DIR}/verdict.txt" ]; then
            echo "UNKNOWN" > "${QA_DIR}/verdict.txt"
          fi

      - name: Upload QA artifacts
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: qa-testing-output
          path: ${{ env.QA_DIR }}/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 7

  post-results:
    needs: [check-secrets, ai-qa-testing]
    if: always() && needs.check-secrets.result != 'skipped'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pull-requests: write

    steps:
      - name: Remove 'ai-qa-test' label
        if: github.event_name == 'pull_request'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --remove-label "ai-qa-test" --repo "$REPOSITORY" || true

      # The upload step uploads the $QA_DIR/ directory, so its contents
      # (qa-report.md and verdict.txt) are stored at the artifact root and
      # download to qa-artifacts/ directly (not qa-artifacts/$QA_DIR/). Later
      # steps rely on these flat paths.
      - name: Download QA artifacts
        id: download
        if: needs.ai-qa-testing.result == 'success'
        uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        continue-on-error: true
        with:
          name: qa-testing-output
          path: qa-artifacts

      - name: Post missing key notice
        if: needs.check-secrets.outputs.has_key == 'false'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --body "ℹ️ **AI QA Testing Not Available via Label**

          The \`ai-qa-test\` label cannot trigger AI QA testing for this PR because the required API key is not available. This typically happens for PRs from forked repositories.

          **To request AI QA testing, a maintainer can:**
          1. Go to the [AI QA Testing workflow](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/actions/workflows/ai-qa-testing.yml)
          2. Click **Run workflow**
          3. Enter the PR number: \`$PR_NUMBER_ENV\`
          4. Click **Run workflow**" --repo "$REPOSITORY"

      - name: Post QA report
        if: needs.check-secrets.outputs.has_key == 'true' && steps.download.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          MODEL_NAME: ${{ env.MODEL }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          if [ -f "qa-artifacts/qa-report.md" ]; then
            # Add footer to report
            {
              echo ""
              echo "---"
              echo "*This is an automated QA report by \`$MODEL_NAME\`.*"
            } >> "qa-artifacts/qa-report.md"

            gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --body-file "qa-artifacts/qa-report.md" --repo "$REPOSITORY"
          else
            gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --body "⚠️ **AI QA Testing completed but no report was generated.**

            Please check the [workflow run](https://github.com/${REPOSITORY}/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}) for details." --repo "$REPOSITORY"
          fi

      - name: Post failure notice
        if: needs.check-secrets.outputs.has_key == 'true' && (needs.ai-qa-testing.result == 'failure' || steps.download.outcome != 'success')
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
          SERVER_URL: ${{ github.server_url }}
          RUN_ID: ${{ github.run_id }}
        run: |
          gh pr comment "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --body "⚠️ **AI QA Testing Failed**

          The AI QA testing job failed to complete. Please check the [workflow run](${SERVER_URL}/$REPOSITORY/actions/runs/${RUN_ID}) for details.

          You can retry by adding the 'ai-qa-test' label again or manually triggering the workflow." --repo "$REPOSITORY"

      - name: Apply label based on verdict
        if: needs.check-secrets.outputs.has_key == 'true' && steps.download.outcome == 'success'
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          PR_NUMBER_ENV: ${{ env.PR_NUMBER }}
          REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          if [ ! -f "qa-artifacts/verdict.txt" ]; then
            echo "Warning: verdict.txt not found, skipping label"
            exit 0
          fi

          VERDICT=$(tr -d '[:space:]' < "qa-artifacts/verdict.txt")
          case "$VERDICT" in
            FAIL)
              echo "Adding 'do-not-merge' label"
              gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER_ENV" --add-label "do-not-merge" --repo "$REPOSITORY"
              ;;
            PASS)
              # A QA PASS must not lift a review hold. Only ai-pr-review.yml
              # or a human may remove do-not-merge, including a hold this job added on FAIL.
              echo "QA PASS does not remove 'do-not-merge'; re-add 'ai-review' or remove the label manually"
              ;;
            *)
              echo "Verdict is $VERDICT - no label changes"
              ;;
          esac

      - name: Write step summary
        env:
          QA_RESULT: ${{ needs.ai-qa-testing.result }}
          HAS_KEY: ${{ needs.check-secrets.outputs.has_key }}
        run: |
          {
            echo "## AI QA Testing Summary"
            echo "- PR: #$PR_NUMBER"
            echo "- Model: $MODEL"
            echo "- Result: $QA_RESULT"
            if [ "$HAS_KEY" = "false" ]; then
              echo "- Note: API key not available (fork PR)"
            fi
            if [ -f "qa-artifacts/verdict.txt" ]; then
              echo "- Verdict: $(cat "qa-artifacts/verdict.txt")"

name: AI Test Coverage

on:
  schedule:

  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      model:
        description: "Model to use for coverage improvement"
        required: false
        type: string
        default: "grok-4.7-xhigh"
      dry_run:
        description: "Run without creating PR"
        type: boolean
        required: false
        default: false

env:
  MODEL: ${{ inputs.model || 'grok-4.7-xhigh' }}

jobs:
  check-secrets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    if: github.repository == 'streamlit/streamlit'
    outputs:
      has_key: ${{ steps.check-key.outputs.has_key }}
    steps:
      - name: Check for API key
        id: check-key
        env:
          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          if [ -z "$CURSOR_API_KEY" ]; then
            echo "has_key=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            echo "::warning::CURSOR_API_KEY is not available."
          else
            echo "has_key=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          fi

  ai-frontend-coverage:
    needs: check-secrets
    if: needs.check-secrets.outputs.has_key == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest-8-cores
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
    concurrency:
      group: ${{ github.workflow }}-ai-frontend-coverage
      cancel-in-progress: true
    outputs:
      develop_sha: ${{ steps.get-sha.outputs.sha }}

    defaults:
      run:
        shell: bash

    steps:
      - name: Checkout Streamlit code
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

          ref: develop
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

        uses: ./.github/actions/make_init
        with:
          python_version: ${{ env.PYTHON_MAX_VERSION }}

      - name: Install Cursor CLI
        run: |
          curl https://cursor.com/install -fsS | bash
          echo "$HOME/.cursor/bin" >> $GITHUB_PATH

      - name: AI frontend coverage improvement
        env:
          CURSOR_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.CURSOR_API_KEY }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO_NAME: ${{ github.repository }}
        run: |
          PROMPT="You are operating in a GitHub Actions runner to improve frontend test coverage.

          ## Context
          - Repository: ${REPO_NAME}
          - Main branch: develop

          The repository is checked out at develop with full git history.
          The dev environment is set up - you can run make commands.

          ## Task
          Run the /improving-frontend-coverage skill to systematically increase frontend test coverage
          by approximately 0.2%.

          Implement all test improvements directly. Do not ask for confirmation.

          After completing the improvements, write a summary to 'work-tmp/changes.md' listing all
          modifications made (create the work-tmp directory if it doesn't exist). If no changes were needed, write 'No frontend coverage improvements needed.' to work-tmp/changes.md
          "
          cursor-agent -p "$PROMPT" --force --model "$MODEL" --output-format=text

      - name: Create patch
        id: create-patch
        run: |
          mkdir -p work-tmp
          if [ ! -f work-tmp/changes.md ]; then
            echo "No frontend coverage improvements needed." > work-tmp/changes.md
          fi

          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            echo "changes_found=true" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
            git add -A
            git diff --cached --binary > work-tmp/frontend-coverage.patch

            git diff --cached --stat
          else
            echo "changes_found=false" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

    needs: check-secrets
